def parse_fort07(filepath):
    """Parse FORT07 file to extract EVOLUTION data."""
    results = {}
    
    try:
        with open(filepath, "r", encoding="latin-1", errors="ignore") as f:
            content = f.read()
    except:
        return results
    
    # Split by EVOLUTION sections
    evolutions = content.split("EVOLUTION ")
    
    for evol in evolutions[1:]:  # Skip first split (before any EVOLUTION)

            continue
            
        try:
            # Extract variable name (first word after EVOLUTION)

                continue
            name = evol[:name_end].strip()
            
            # Determine if using TIME or Z coordinate
            x = "TIME"
            xname = "TIME_"

                x = "ZSW"
                xname = "Z_"
            elif "\nZS " in evol:
                x = "ZS"
                xname = "Z_"

            x_header_pos = evol.find(x)
            if x_header_pos == -1:
                continue
            
            # Find the beginning of x values (next line after header)
            x_beg = evol.find("\n", x_header_pos) + 1
            if x_beg == 0:
                continue

            # The line count marker appears as a line with just spaces and numbers
            x_end = x_beg

                next_newline = evol.find("\n", x_end)
                if next_newline == -1:
                    break
                line = evol[x_end:next_newline]
                # Check if this line looks like a line count (only spaces and numbers)
                if line.strip().isdigit() and len(line.strip()) < 10:

                    break
                x_end = next_newline + 1
                lines_checked += 1
            
            # Extract x-axis values (TIME or Z)
            x_str = evol[x_beg:x_end].replace("\n", "").strip()

                    x_values.append(float(part))
                except ValueError:
                    pass
            
            if not x_values:
                continue
            
            # Find data section: skip line count, then skip metadata line
            # Line count is a line with just spaces and digits
            dat_start = x_end
            # Skip the line count line
            dat_start = evol.find("\n", dat_start) + 1
            # Skip the metadata line (e.g., "LIQMASS         KG        CANAL...")
            dat_start = evol.find("\n", dat_start) + 1
            
            if dat_start <= 0:
                continue
            
            # Extract data values until we hit next section or end
            dat_end = dat_start
            lines_checked = 0

                next_newline = evol.find("\n", dat_end)
                if next_newline == -1:
                    dat_end = len(evol)
                    break
                line = evol[dat_end:next_newline]
                # Stop if we hit another line count marker
                if line.strip().isdigit() and len(line.strip()) < 10:
                    break
                dat_end = next_newline + 1
                lines_checked += 1
            
            # Extract data values
            dat_str = evol[dat_start:dat_end].replace("\n", "").strip()
            dat_values = []
            for part in dat_str.split():
                try:
                    dat_values.append(float(part))
                except ValueError:
                    break  # Stop at first non-numeric value
            
            # Store results - match the length to x_values
            if dat_values:
                results[name] = dat_values[:len(x_values)]
                results[xname + name] = x_values
            
        except Exception as e:
            # Skip problematic sections
            continue
    
    return results
